name: Cosmology
summary: Cosmology studies the origin, evolution and large-scale properties of the universe as a whole — its age, composition, geometry and expansion history. The concordance model is flat ΛCDM, anchored by the cosmic microwave background and large-scale structure.

priorities.text: Resolve the Hubble tension — the disagreement between early-universe (CMB-inferred) and late-universe (distance-ladder) measurements of the expansion rate.
Map dark energy and test whether general relativity holds on cosmological scales with next-generation surveys.

openQuestions.text: What is the physical nature of dark energy, and is it a cosmological constant?
Why do early- and late-universe measurements of the Hubble constant disagree (the Hubble tension)?
